registeredBeforeResults: When this file was committed no A14 number existed: no tag had been counted on any split and tools/gapper-study/a14_cause_census.py had not been written. Known at that moment: amendment 08's census by stored catalyst (59% of train gapper days with no stored item, 11.7% coverage only), the 08:00 feature-block ablation and top features by gain (runs/explore/models-20261109-1619.md), H15's repeat-runner lift, and the watchlist's strongest inputs as listed in gapper-anatomy-and-tradability.md.
question: Which conditions knowable at the D-1 close are over-represented before a gapper day, how much does each and each combination raise the odds, and how many gapper days does no condition explain?
kind: descriptive, detection only; no trade is simulated
population: Every symbol-day D eligible at the D-1 close by amendment-13.json eligibilityAtS, D in 2021-11-01..2024-10-31 (train).

outcomes.G20: D daily high / split-adjusted D-1 close - 1 >= 0.20
outcomes.note: Regular-hours daily bars; premarket-only spikes are not counted. Recovery of the frozen train Tier20 events is reported.

tags.ranLast5: any of D-5..D-2 with high / prior close - 1 >= 0.20
tags.bigRunner60: any of D-60..D-6 with high / prior close - 1 >= 0.50
tags.closedStrong: D-1 close / D-2 close - 1 >= 0.10 AND D-1 close >= low + 0.75 x (high - low)
tags.reverseSplit90: reverse split ex-date within the 90 calendar days through D-1
tags.newListing180: first daily bar within 180 calendar days of D
tags.hotTape: count of eligible symbols with ranYesterday on that date in the top quarter of train dates up to then (expanding quantile)
tags.dilutionFiling90: S-1, S-3, 424B3, 424B4 or 424B5 for the symbol's CIK accepted in the 90 days through D-1 16:00 ET; no CIK = unknown
tags.eightK5: 8-K or 8-K/A accepted in the 5 calendar days through D-1 16:00 ET; no CIK = unknown
tags.insiderBuy30: Form 4 transaction code P in the 30 days through D-1
tags.tinyShares: latest XBRL shares outstanding filed before D-1 < 10,000,000 where held; otherwise unknown

newsTags.scope: candidate days plus amendment 01's sample only, with its weights (stored news exists only around those days)
newsTags.freshNews: a non-coverage stored item published after D-1 16:00 ET and before 04:00 ET on D
newsTags.staleNews5: a non-coverage stored item in D-5..D-1 16:00 ET and no freshNews

combinations.stable: overall lift lower bound > 2 AND P(G20) above the base rate in all four evaluation windows

statistics.interval: day-clustered bootstrap, 95%, 2,000 draws for combinations and 10,000 for single tags, seed 1337
statistics.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.05 across every tag and combination, one-sided P(G20 | set) > base rate

reported: frozen train Tier20/50/100 events versus matched controls

decisionRules.ledger: every tag and combination tested is a ledger trial
decisionRules.promotion: nothing is promoted; a stable combination is a candidate for a later amendment registered before its own numbers
decisionRules.followUp: if more than 30% of G50 days carry no tag, the result names the data ticket that could shrink the remainder
